summary: RideBuddy MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed covering auth (send/verify OTP), users/me, garage CRUD, fare estimation (new-user 10% discount, hourly, round trip), full booking lifecycle (create -> auto-assign driver in ~3s -> verify-start with wrong/correct code -> verify-end -> completed with paid_amount=total_fare), cancel, list sorted desc. Frontend: login -> OTP -> profile -> add car -> book point-to-point -> estimate -> confirm UPI -> booking detail with driver assigned (Rajesh Kumar 4.9*), start/end codes 2313/0679 visible, Aadhaar/Police badges, call/chat buttons all render correctly. Map shows static unsplash image as expected (MOCKED).

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside seed_drivers() on startup but logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) is defined AFTER the function definition. Works because Python resolves names at call-time, but is fragile; move logging.basicConfig + logger above @app.on_event('startup').
InsecureKeyLengthWarning: JWT_SECRET is 24 bytes; recommend >=32 bytes for HS256.

issues: Console warning: 'Route profile/add-car is extraneous'. The add-car screen is nested inside (tabs) folder but is not registered properly OR is being declared as a Tabs screen when it should be a Stack screen. Should be moved out of (tabs) or wrapped via expo-router Stack.
Deprecation warnings: shadow* style props (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Not blocking but should be cleaned up.
name-input and email-input have readonly attribute until 'Edit' is tapped. This is acceptable UX but means tests must tap Edit first; consider adding a testID='edit-profile-btn' for testability.

action_items: Fix expo-router warning: 'Route profile/add-car is extraneous' in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx — either remove the extra Tabs.Screen entry or relocate add-car outside the (tabs) group as a Stack route.
Add testID='edit-profile-btn' to the Edit button on profile screen for better testability.
Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents (Expo SDK upgrade hygiene).
Optional: Increase JWT_SECRET length to >=32 chars to remove InsecureKeyLengthWarning.
Optional: Move logger init above @app.on_event('startup') in backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend compute_fare correctly applies 10% new-user discount; verify-end correctly flips is_new=false (matches spec).
auto_assign_driver uses asyncio.create_task — works but on a single-worker dev server; ensure not used with --workers >1 (not currently configured).
MongoDB _id properly excluded via {'_id': 0} projection across all queries — good.
Backend always returns hydrated 'driver' object in GET /bookings/{id} — frontend can rely on it.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 5 drivers automatically on startup; tests create ephemeral users/cars/bookings prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (note: not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) from frontend/.env. Mock OTP accepts any 6-digit string; 4-digit start/end codes generated server-side at assignment. Auto-assign delay is asyncio.sleep(3) — poll up to ~5-6s. Profile inputs need 'Edit' button tapped first (readonly until then). is_new flips to false on profile update OR first completed trip, so discount may disappear after editing profile (this is spec).
rca_of_issue: No production bugs found. Two minor warnings in frontend console (deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents) and one expo-router layout warning ('profile/add-car extraneous') — none block functionality. The Profile readonly-until-Edit behavior caused initial test fill failure; resolved by clicking Edit first.
